title: Databases and sources that send data
description:
A database queried every period next to a source that sends data all the time: both
show new data at most once per **interval**, and the top-level interval refreshes all
panels at once. See `:help dbdash-interval`.

query.sql: SELECT strftime('%H:%M:%S', 'now', 'localtime') AS queried, abs(random() % 100) AS value

show.title: Queried every 5s
show.description: A query on each tick of its 5 s interval, and on the top-level one.

query.sql:
-- A reading every 300 ms for ten minutes: many items per period.
for i = 1, 2000 do
  print(vim.json.encode({ n = i, at = os.date("%H:%M:%S") }))
  dbdash.sleep(300)
end
query.transform:
-- every item goes through here; the panel shows the latest once per period
store.received = (store.received or 0) + 1
local item = vim.json.decode(rs)
return { { item = item.n, at = item.at, received = store.received } }

show.title: Sent every 300 ms, shown every 3s
show.description:
`luastream://` sends an item every 300 ms; each one goes through `query.transform`,
the panel shows the latest at most once per 3 s period.

show.title: Every 1m: with the others
show.description:
Its interval (1 m) is longer than the top-level one (20 s): it refreshes only with
all panels.
